name: hud_sensor_tracker_on_objective_command
description: HudSensorTracker::OnObjectiveCommand dispatches objective review/panel commands and map overlay/zoom commands through the global HudSensorTracker, respecting the objective-command lock and network map gate. Direct production host: mission.cpp.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to the coherent HudSensorTracker map/objective command cluster because the original switch lowering, tail calls, global tracker address materialization, and neighboring /Ob1 member-call context need to be reviewed together.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x417ca0 validates the commandId - 0x18 jump table, locked guards for commands 0x18 through 0x1a, global g_HudSensorTracker tail dispatch to AdvanceObjectiveState, Command_ToggleObjectivePanel, and Command_ShowObjectivePickupInfo, network-disabled or allow-maps gated MapOverlayRefToggle for command 0x1b, and direct MapZoomIn/MapZoomOut dispatch for commands 0x1c and 0x1d.

The native objective-panel smoke verifies the locked command 0x18 no-op, unlocked command 0x18 objective-advance dispatch, command 0x19 panel-toggle dispatch, command 0x1b map-overlay hide toggle with network disabled, and command 0x1c/0x1d map zoom in/out dispatch against the staged global HudSensorTracker.
